exposure: ultrasound estimated percentile weight (EPW) at 35 weeks of pregnancy
NC World Health Organization (WHO) international standards
outcome: Cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal status
Instrumental delivery for nonreassuring fetal status
finding: The predictive capacity of the EPW for adverse perinatal outcomes is limited and similar, by both ultrasound and at delivery, for the 5 growth standards, without significant differences between customized and non-customized standards.
